comment: The design-lint gate's exemptions, read by `node scripts/design-lint.mjs --strict` (the `design:gate` step of `bun run ci:local`). Every violation outside this file fails the gate. `allow` is permanent and reported on every run as `allowed`; `deferred` is temporary and held to the baseline ratchet only. The gate also fails on an entry that matches no violation, so an exemption cannot outlive what it excused.

allow.reason: Brand art: the GitPulse mark's gradient stops are the logo's own colors. No design token maps to them, and tokenizing them would make the mark change with the theme.
Brand art: the MarkDev mark's gradient stops belong to another product's identity. No design token maps to them, and they must not follow the theme.

Vendor term: a Firebase project and a Google Cloud project are the vendor's own objects, not repositories. Backends live on a project and the App Hosting API is enabled on one, so the copy must say project. Only the bare uses remain here; the qualified ones (Firebase project, project alias, project ID) pass by shape.

deferred.reason: Lane P is retuning the menu-bar popover in parallel. At merge, delete this entry and retake the baseline (`node scripts/design-lint.mjs --baseline`); the gate then holds the file at zero.
Lane R is moving the highlighter in parallel. At merge, delete this entry and retake the baseline (`node scripts/design-lint.mjs --baseline`); the gate then holds the file at zero.
